objective: Retrieve the smallest scientifically relevant subgraph needed for the current commercial diagnosis and writing goal.
seed_sources: S5 mechanism_hypotheses with candidate or strong_candidate status
explicit message-design nodes required by the output task
traversal: Include seed nodes even when provisional, but preserve their provisional state.
Prefer accepted scientific edges for one-hop expansion.
Allow provisional edges only when directly relevant to an unresolved decision and attach uncertainty.
Default graph horizon is one hop; allow two hops only when required to explain mediation/conflict or a critical strategy dependency.
Never traverse an edge solely because it increases graph density.
Do not retrieve every node in a core.
Do not convert same-core adjacency into an implied scientific edge.
exclusion_rules: Exclude nodes contradicted by explicit current facts unless retained as counter-hypotheses.
Exclude provisional marketing/design nodes from dominant-mechanism status unless no accepted construct can represent the need.
Exclude scientific details that cannot change strategy, copy, testing, or critique for this task.
stopping_rule: Stop retrieval when additional nodes no longer change a material strategy decision, conflict, uncertainty, or experiment candidate.
